ABOUT
Ship Builder is an offline outfitting bench for Elite Dangerous.
APP VERSION 4.2.1 · LIBRARY VERSION 3.8.0.3
FAQ
What can I import?
A SLEF export from Coriolis, EDSY or Inara, or a raw Loadout event from your journal folder.
Where are my builds stored?
In this browser. Clearing site data deletes them, so export anything you want to keep.
Do share links expose my account?
No. A link carries only the loadout, encoded in the URL fragment.
Why do my engineered stats differ in game?
Rolls vary in quality. Imported modules keep their real roll; new blueprints are shown at full grade.
